architecture.description: Single-file Python entry point; MCP server for Immich REST API with container and test tooling.

outbound.interface: Immich REST API via OpenAPI spec

design-decisions.decision: Start with a single-file entry point to iterate quickly.

concern.vulnerability: API keys or tokens could be logged or transmitted insecurely.
concern.mitigation: Use environment variables only, avoid logging secrets, and require HTTPS for remote use.

feature.title: Immich MCP server and core tools
feature.description: FastMCP server with config-driven HTTP requests and read-only Immich tools.

feature.title: Docker packaging for the MCP server
feature.description: Dockerfile and docker-compose workflow for containerized runs.

feature.title: Unit-test environment
feature.description: Pytest-based unit tests and documentation for running tests.

feature.title: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
feature.description: Expose Immich endpoints via MCP using the OpenAPI spec as the source of truth.

feature.title: Adapt Immich REST API features to MCP tools
feature.description: Expand MCP tool coverage to align with core Immich REST API features.

feature.title: Add Docker image and docker-compose setup
feature.description: Provide a containerized workflow to build and run the MCP server with a mapped port.

feature.title: Implement unit-test environment for the MCP server
feature.description: Enable repeatable testing of MCP tools and HTTP interactions to reduce regressions.
